● MEMORY
02 · LEARNS SOMETHING EVERY WEEK
Three layers of memory.
Most shop tools forget everything the moment you close them.
TODAY
The right notes for the job on the bench right now.
“Here are the 12 repairs that used this chain, and who ordered it.”
THIS MONTH
Where you left off, and what changed since Friday.
“Last week you were on wheel builds. Since then, the spoke supplier changed.”
ALWAYS
What the workshop has learned, shared with everyone.
“Squeaky brakes? Check the pad alignment first. Found in March, confirmed eleven times.”
● Learned on Monday, known by the whole crew on Wednesday.
● It notes when something is no longer true.
● When volunteers move on, what they knew stays.

BRING YOUR OWN TOOLS
Any till. Any app. Your pick, and you can switch later.
Fernwick doesn’t sell you a till. Use Ledgerly, Tallyhouse, Pinecart, or the point-of-sale system already running in the shop today.
Switch systems without losing anything. The notes, the history, the boards and the access rules stay with the workshop, not with the vendor.
Your crew’s own apps (calendars, chat, spreadsheets and others) connect to the same notes and history, under the same access rules.
Hosted on site, as a service. We pick the hardware, set it up in your back office or your cloud, and run it for you. Then nothing leaves.
THE SOFTWARE IS SWAPPABLE
The workshop’s notes, history and controls are yours.

WHY THE OWNER SAYS YES
Your login. Your access rules. Your hardware. Your data. Everything logged.
WHERE DOES OUR DATA GO?
It stays with you.
On your own hardware. Outside services only see what you send them; nothing else leaves the shop.
WHO CAN IT ACT AS?
Only the person asking.
With the permissions they already have. Never more.
CAN IT CHANGE THINGS ON ITS OWN?
No.
Every change waits for a person to approve it.
WHICH TILL DOES IT USE?
Your choice.
Ledgerly, Tallyhouse, or your own system on your own hardware.
CAN WE AUDIT IT?
Every step.
Questions, runs and changes, logged and exportable.
CAN WE SWITCH IT OFF?
Any time.
The data stays yours.
